statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ), 2 ≤ N → let z : ℕ → ℂ := fun ξ => ((N : ℝ).sqrt : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N, (a n : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (ξ : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)); (∑ ξ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N, (z ξ) ^ 2 + (z 0) ^ 2 = ((∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N, a n * a (N - n) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧ (‖z 0‖ ^ 2 - ∑ ξ ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N, ‖z ξ‖ ^ 2 = 2 / (N : ℝ) * (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N, a n) ^ 2 - ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N, (a n) ^ 2)
